what: Domain decision: aide-memory.dev — matches npm package name, GitHub repo name, and all existing branding. Consistent everywhere: npm (aide-memory), GitHub (aide-memory), domain (aide-memory.dev), CLI output. If a suite domain is needed later for other AIDE products, can get useaide.dev or similar separately.
why: Domain finalized after exploring alternatives (aide.tools taken, considered useaide.dev, aidemem.dev). Consistency with existing naming won.
